name: A10-0290/2026 – Emma Ytterell – After recital 3 – Am 119
title: REPORT on the proposal for a regulation of the European Parliament and of the Council on speeding-up environmental assessments
part_text: (3a) While the Draghi report provided valuable and actionable recommendations for structural reform, the Commission has predominantly utilised them to justify further regulation and centralisation of competencies.
